geyser.title: Bedrock Crossplay (Geyser)
geyser.enableHint: Lets console, mobile and Windows (Bedrock) players join this Java server via Geyser.
geyser.floodgateHint: Recommended: Bedrock players connect using their Xbox/Microsoft account without owning Minecraft Java. When disabled, they must sign in with a valid Java account.
geyser.addressHint: Address and UDP port to enter in Minecraft Bedrock.
geyser.udpPortHint: Open and forward port {port}/UDP (not TCP) to this host on your router and firewall.
geyser.recreateNotice: Restart or recreate the server to apply the UDP port binding and load Geyser.
geyser.enabledToast: Geyser enabled — restart the server to apply
geyser.disabledToast: Geyser disabled — restart the server to apply
geyser.floodgateUpdatedToast: Floodgate option updated — restart the server to apply
geyser.unsupportedDefault: This loader does not support Geyser (supported loaders: Fabric, NeoForge, Paper, Purpur).
geyser.footer: Assigned UDP port for this server: {port}/UDP (separate from the Java TCP port).
geyser.footerDisabled: Geyser and Floodgate are automatically downloaded from Modrinth matching this server version.
